speedster.briefing: Full speed on ramps (need 1.7/1.9 m/s). Slow for the log at 22-30 m. Burn fan ONCE at the 0.9 m gap edge (30-38 m), then coast.
speedster.rationale: The stock Speedster already covers every need. Camera scans both survivors, ultrasonic scans the structure and sees the log, and the fan clears the 0.9 m gap. No swaps are justified. The small battery is tight, so the fan gets a single burn.

partsWhy.why: Clears the 0.9 m gap with no ramp; use once to save battery.
Scans both survivors (4 m, 19 m) and reads the terrain ahead.
Only sensor that scans the structure at 42 m; also spots the log.

mud_crawler.briefing: Max speed. Ramps at 14m and 50m: full speed, never under 1.9 m/s. Drive over the log at 22m. Fire piston at the edge of the gap at 30-38m.
mud_crawler.rationale: Tracks, torque motor and large battery stay. The 0.9 m gap with no ramp needs a piston, so it replaces the waterproof case, which is useless on a dry track. The camera replaces the IMU and scans both survivors, saving 20 s. Only one sensor swap is allowed, so the structure scan is skipped.

partsWhy.why: Needed to jump the 0.9 m gap on the grass with no ramp.
Scans both survivors and reads the terrain 6 m ahead.
Kept: clears the log and holds grip on the grass.

all_rounder.briefing: Scan at 4m,19m,42m: slow down. Full speed on ramps (14m,50m). Ease over log 22m. Fire piston at gap edge 30-38m, then continue.
all_rounder.rationale: Keeps the all-rounder's wheels, motor, battery and both sensors. The camera covers both survivors and the ultrasonic covers the structure. The 0.9 m gap at 30-38 m has no ramp, so the bumper is swapped for a piston, the cheaper and lighter option compared with the fan.

partsWhy.why: Only way to clear the 0.9 m ramp-less gap; cheaper and lighter than the fan.
Scans both survivors and reads the terrain ahead.
Only sensor that scans the cracked structure; also sees the log.

deep_diver.briefing: Full speed on ramps (14-22m, 50-58m). Ease off at log 22m. Fire piston at the 0.9m gap near 30-38m. Scan at 4m, 19m, 42m. Slow there.
deep_diver.rationale: No water on this track, so the thruster kit is dead weight. The 0.9 m gap with no ramp needs a piston, which is lighter and cheaper than the fan. Camera covers the survivors and ultrasonic covers the structure, so both stay.

partsWhy.why: Clears the 0.9 m gap at 30-38 m that has no ramp.
Needed to scan the survivors at 4 m and 19 m.
Only sensor that scans the structure at 42 m; also sees the log.
Removed: no water on this track.
